description:
Hee-joo, an art therapist, will consult with killer Su-hyun, who believes he is a terrible monster. Once a week, during 10 consultations,  
What did he find in his painting? Can Su-hyun heal, why was the monster made, and who was the monster?

The remaining time until the statute of limitations on the murder of the mother of art therapist Hee-joo is 10 weeks.  
And Su-hyun, a time-limited patient who believes that she is a terrible monster who visited Hee-ju.  
The two begin a 10-week art therapy.

The story of art therapy counseling between Hee-joo, an art therapist who wants to make him live, and Su-hyun, a killer who does not want to live.

[Original Novel](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=9318396)
